'''Ullisric''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] whose forces on [[Adinai]] were found to be ill-equipped despite generous funding due to the presence of corruption.
